source.quote: After a regional outage, viewing must be back within 15 minutes; uploads may take up to an hour.

data_categories.value: photos, videos, profile data, synced contacts and coarse location tags

source.quote: we hold users' photos, videos, profile data, contacts they choose to sync, and coarse location tags

source.why: Private photos and videos, synced contacts and coarse location at very large scale; no health, financial or precise-tracking data is named and children are excluded.

unknowns.question: How much stored media is viewed again after its first year?
unknowns.why_it_matters: It decides how much can move to colder, cheaper storage, the main lever for the cost cut.

unknowns.question: Will the Brazilian residency rule extend to backups?
unknowns.why_it_matters: If it does, backups of Brazilian media must stay in Brazil too, which changes backup and regional recovery.
